resources.string: Use E-Hentai without credentials, or securely connect the same source to ExHentai with your existing session cookies.
Use ExHentai when all three saved cookies are available; otherwise use public E-Hentai.
Always use public E-Hentai. Saved ExHentai credentials stay encrypted but are not injected.
Prefer ExHentai when ipb_member_id, ipb_pass_hash, and igneous are complete.
These values are stored encrypted with Android Keystore under app-private no-backup storage. They are never written to Source Pack metadata or logs.
ExHentai preferred, but the three cookies are not complete; E-Hentai will be used.
Configure public E-Hentai or authenticated ExHentai access for the global source.
